item.title: Industry News: Watch: Flock of turkeys chases woman on Massachusetts pavement
item.description: Two people were driving when they encountered a woman being chased by turkeys down the pavement in Newton, Massachusetts. The woman stated she had to jump into a stranger's car to escape them. No injuries were reported to the woman or the turkeys. → Read original article...
